01_selected_spectra.caption: Selected curves span substantial within-category variation; dark lines are medians. Connecting segments do not represent continuous hyperspectral measurements.

02_coverage_controls.caption: Random controls preserve all 367 selected polygon identities and the selected pixel count per polygon. Bars show central 95% of 30 random draws, not population confidence intervals.

03_category_agreement.caption: Evergreen matches labels through this nearest-reference rule more reliably than Woody shrub and Herbaceous. Each source domain is visible, but the endmember selection saw all domains.

04_cross_category_ambiguity.caption: Full-library linear programs exclude every reference with the target label. Verified alternatives use nonnegative sum-one weights; multiple references per category and up to eight active references are allowed. These are not restricted three-material MESMA solutions.

05_synthetic_recovery.caption: Primary MESMA screens three references per category from the full library, then tests 375 admitted models with at most three categories. Error bars are conditional whole-bundle bootstrap intervals; eight bundles do not provide broad ecological validation.

06_sensitivity.caption: Screening 1, 2, 3 or 5 candidates per class does not beat the dense prior, but beats the three-category sparse prior in this synthetic design. These follow-up checks do not exhaust the full 16.9-million-model search. Near-fit tolerances are illustrative, not independently measured sensor noise.
